exploiters.b1: det exploiter vs frozen learned_det, scratch, total-steps 1e+07, jseed 320000 + idx*100 + seed
exploiters.b3: det exploiter vs frozen learned_det, scratch, total-steps 3e+07, jseed 325000 + idx*100 + seed

production.recipe: identical to the E7-b det exploiter except budget and jseed (--exploit ckpt --stack r4p + world flags of the variant)

evaluation.exploiters: b1, b3 (new) + b3_at1e7, b3_at2e7 snapshots (report) + original E7-b 1e7 exploiter re-evaluated with --env-seed 0 (report)
evaluation.metric: defended (eval.summarize; same ceiling definition as E7-b) + net (report)

rule.d: per slot d = ceil(b1) - ceil(b3), learned_det
rule.labels: BUDGET_UNDERTRAINED: median d >= 4 and >= 10/15 slots d > 0; BUDGET_CONVERGED: |median d| < 4; else BUDGET_MIXED
report: plateau median ceiling at b1 / b3 / original
exploiter final penetration (train log) per budget
b3_at1e7 / b3_at2e7 snapshots: within-seed budget curve (report only)
rule.meaning: CONVERGED = budget effect below ~4/240 (1.7 pp) given median SE ~2 — not a proof of convergence. UNDERTRAINED = all ceilings so far are upper estimates of performance against stronger red teams; the H1 plateau '~8%' becomes '<= ~8%' (direction of the story kept: the adaptive evader sets the ceiling; only the number goes down)

power_memo: R0: per-slot env-seed SD <= binomial (~4/240 at p ~ .09); a paired b1-b3 difference has SD ~ 6 incl. exploiter-seed scatter -> median of 15 has SE ~ 2; threshold 4 ~ 2 SE
